description: Queued and historical jobs: reusable job protocols and immutable task projection in api-client, with connected queue state, caching, presentation, scheduling, recovery, submission, and registry contributions in the application. Execution routing, shared output contracts, media URLs, authentication, subscription gates, and shell positioning have separate owners.

characterizationScenarios.name: Jobs client fetches queue, history pages, details, and assets with schema validation
Queue store merges running, pending, and history jobs and reloads their workflows
Job list groups, filters, estimates, and exposes job menu actions
Queue overlay, notification banners, and progress render active and finished jobs
Actionbar run button queues prompts with batch count and run modes and shows queue progress
Auto-queue requeues on change or instant mode and respects the partner-node run gate
Job detail, outputs, assets, and workflows are fetched and cached per job
Job display state, reconnect refresh, and job-history sidebar registration follow queue state
Submission preserves per-instance concurrency, extension callbacks, legacy transitions, and lifecycle cleanup

compatibilityPromises: Package job modules depend only on package contracts. App consumers use package export subpaths, while caching and graph effects remain in app integration.
Pinia store IDs, settings IDs, command IDs, telemetry names, sidebar registration, and extension-facing app.queuePrompt overloads retain their behavior.

Submission remains per-instance and preserves pending-request LIFO order, concurrent enqueue-then-false results, per-batch widget callbacks, captured workflow metadata, and completed batch event counts.
Legacy queue DOM and modern queue views retain their distinct workflow restoration and auto-queue policies.
